metadata.description: ReversePort: reverse engineer anything, port it anywhere — one MCP server, skills and a porting agent. Also lists its sister plugins Stashpad (agent memory) and agentdisk (agent disk cleanup).

plugins.name: reverseport
plugins.description: Reverse engineer anything. Port it anywhere. Recon, decompile and trace apps, games, binaries and websites; rebuild and port them between Godot, Unity, Unreal, three.js and languages.

plugins.name: stashpad
plugins.description: Memory for AI agents that you can read, edit and trust: plain Markdown files with sources and dates, a review queue for agent writes, and a handoff note for the next session. Stores ReversePort's proof-case findings when both are installed.

plugins.name: agentdisk
plugins.description: The honest disk report for AI coding agents: worktrees, checkpoints, caches, node_modules and .godot folders agents left behind, and a cleanup you can undo. Needs the agentdisk binary on PATH.
